feedback.correct: To‘g‘ri. Manbaning tayyor atom kartasi Fe+S=FeS, nisbat1:1:1. Butun-sonli modelda M(Fe)=56, M(S)=32, M(FeS)=88 g/mol. FeS uchun 22 g/88 g/mol=0,25 mol. Atom kartasi haqiqiy moddani amalda tayyorlash topshirig‘i emas.
feedback.incorrect: Hozircha noto‘g‘ri. Manbaning tayyor atom kartasi Fe+S=FeS, nisbat1:1:1. Butun-sonli modelda M(Fe)=56, M(S)=32, M(FeS)=88 g/mol. FeS uchun 22 g/88 g/mol=0,25 mol. Atom kartasi haqiqiy moddani amalda tayyorlash topshirig‘i emas.
feedback.invalid_answer: Belgilar registri, indeks va qavslarni tekshiring. Formula yoki tenglamani ko‘rsatilgan shaklda yozing.
feedback.incorrect_species: Moddalar formulasi yoki chap/o‘ng tomoni berilgan reaksiyaga mos emas. Manbaning tayyor atom kartasi Fe+S=FeS, nisbat1:1:1.
